correction.behavior: Enumerate exact safe path literals with the same left/right boundaries as GraceExecutionPipeline.artifact_path_is_named. Sentence-final periods are separators; candidate path bytes are never normalized. Full-token enumeration prevents prefix/extension matches.

correction.unquoted_bare_extensionless_limit: Arbitrary unquoted root-level extensionless words cannot be distinguished reliably from ordinary prose and are not enumerated. The prompt continues to require clarification when no explicit destination is named; the controller pipeline remains the final exact-path guard. No broad text-word enum or inferred authorization is added.
